two-row or full DP table with nested while loops

difficulty_notes: Small and algorithmic; the language traps are the region scratch with an empty effect row, the borrowed Vec of text slices, and std.utf8's Step enum. The Unicode trap is in the oracle (café, 日本語, ü/ue, naïve). The audit adds 5 property checks from the brief (symmetry, zero-iff-equal, triangle, similarity range, malformed no-panic) over a fixed 14-string pool; the 49 oracle cases are vendored unchanged. Properties need no hidden knowledge beyond the brief.
